name: Guatemala (1851–1858)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes: the upper divided vertically red at the hoist and blue at the fly, the middle white, and the lower divided vertically yellow at the hoist and blue at the fly.
history: Adopted on 14 November 1851 by the conservative, pro-Spanish government of Rafael Carrera, which added the Spanish red and yellow to the Central American blue and white to mark the break with the liberal federation. It was replaced on 31 May 1858 by a horizontally striped flag in the same colours.
